---
title: Data Cleaning
format: typst
---

```{r}
g24_sov_by_g24_svprec <- read_csv("Downloads/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec.csv")

g24_candidates_by_district <- read_csv("Downloads/g24-candidates-by-district.csv")

g24_results_by_district <- read_excel("Downloads/g24-results-by-district.xlsx")

```


```{r}
g24_sov_by_g24_svprec_raw <- read_csv("Downloads/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec.csv")

vote_cols <- g24_sov_by_g24_svprec_raw |>
  select(ends_with("VOTE")) |> 
  names()

g24_sov_by_g24_svprec <- g24_sov_by_g24_svprec_raw |>
  mutate(
    across(all_of(vote_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))),
    
    SVPREC_KEY = as.character(SVPREC_KEY),
    SVPREC = as.character(SVPREC),
    COUNTY = as.character(COUNTY),
    CDDIST = as.character(CDDIST),
    ADDIST = as.character(ADDIST)
  )

```

```{r}
g24_results_by_district <- g24_results_by_district |>
  mutate(
    CONTEST = str_squish(as.character(CONTEST)),
    FIELD = str_squish(as.character(FIELD)),
    DISTRICT_TYPE = str_squish(as.character(DISTRICT_TYPE)),
    DISTRICT = str_squish(as.character(DISTRICT)),
    NAME = str_squish(as.character(NAME))
  )
```

```{r}
raw <- read_excel("Downloads/g24-results-by-district.xlsx", col_names = FALSE)

district_headers <- which(str_detect(raw[[1]], "Congressional District"))

all_districts <- list()

for (i in seq_along(district_headers)) {
  
  start_row <- district_headers[i]
  end_row <- if (i < length(district_headers)) district_headers[i+1] - 1 else nrow(raw)
  
  block <- raw[start_row:end_row, ]
  
  block <- block |> mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(. == "", NA, .)))
  
  district_name <- block[1,1] |> pull()
  district_num <- str_extract(district_name, "\\d+")
  district_id <- paste0("CA-", stringr::str_pad(district_num, 2, pad="0"))
  
  dem_candidate <- block[3,2] |> pull() |> str_replace_all("\\r\\n", " ") |> str_squish()
  rep_candidate <- block[3,3] |> pull() |> str_replace_all("\\r\\n", " ") |> str_squish()
  
  dem_party <- block[4,2] |> pull() |> str_squish()
  rep_party <- block[4,3] |> pull() |> str_squish()
  
  county_block <- block[5:nrow(block), ]
  
  stop_row <- which(county_block[[1]] == "District Totals")
  if (length(stop_row) > 0) {
    county_block <- county_block[1:(stop_row-1), ]
  }
  
  names(county_block) <- c("county", "dem_votes", "rep_votes")
  
  county_block <- county_block |>
    mutate(
      county = str_squish(as.character(county)),
      dem_votes = as.numeric(dem_votes),
      rep_votes = as.numeric(rep_votes)
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(county), county != "")
  
  dem_rows <- county_block |>
    transmute(
      district = district_id,
      county,
      candidate = dem_candidate,
      party = dem_party,
      votes = dem_votes
    )
  
  rep_rows <- county_block |>
    transmute(
      district = district_id,
      county,
      candidate = rep_candidate,
      party = rep_party,
      votes = rep_votes
    )
  
  all_districts[[length(all_districts) + 1]] <- bind_rows(dem_rows, rep_rows)
}

g24_results_clean <- bind_rows(all_districts)

dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(g24_results_clean, "data/cleaned-2024-district-results.csv")

```

```{r}
write_csv(g24_results_clean, "data/cleaned-2024-district-results.csv")
```
